questions.label: Which skill creator implementation should be pre-populated?
questions.help: Recommended: bundle the Codex-compatible skill creator skill as the default C4OS skill authoring helper.
options: Install skill creator into user config on first run
Link to external Codex skill creator only

questions.label: Which skill sources should Settings show in the first pass?
questions.help: Recommended: bundled and user-global skills first. Project-local skills depend on FS/workspace activation and can be added later.
options: All skill sources including plugin-provided skills

questions.label: Can plugin-provided skills be enabled separately from their parent plugin?
questions.help: Recommended: plugin-provided skills follow parent plugin enablement in v1 to avoid split-brain extension state.
options: No; plugin-provided skills follow parent plugin enablement
Yes; every skill has independent enablement
Only if the plugin declares independent skill enablement

questions.label: What metadata is required before a skill appears in `$` tagging?
questions.help: Recommended: require a readable name, description, source, and enabled status so tag suggestions are useful and auditable.

Full manifest including icon, version, and permissions
